app_archetype: The Performance Pro & Urban Safety Companion

design_direction.emotional_tone: Energético, confiável, tático e comunitário. Foco na segurança viária urbana com dinamismo cearense.
design_direction.rationale: App de navegação e GPS em tempo real para ciclistas requer alto contraste, legibilidade sob sol forte ou luz noturna, estilo tático e esportivo (Deep Obsidian #0A0F1D com Verde Ciclovia #10B981 e Laranja Alerta #F97316).

surfaces.name: hero
surfaces.guarantee: scrim: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(9, 13, 22, 0.95) 0%, rgba(9, 13, 22, 0.8) 60%, rgba(9, 13, 22, 0.5) 100%)

entry_surfaces./: split hero & interactive live map preview — brand value proposition + CTA on the left, live Fortaleza radar view with obstacle alerts on the right
entry_surfaces./map: immersive full-screen GPS interactive map with collapsible floating tactical HUD, obstacle reporter tool and route layers
entry_surfaces./missions: high-density gamified mission grid with progression rings, level status, seal showcases and leaderboard
entry_surfaces./profile: tactical cyclist stats dashboard with km totals, report ledger, unlocked badges (selos/emblemas) and gear settings
entry_surfaces./login: branded split login — Fortaleza cyclist safety pledge on left with hero visual, auth form on right
entry_surfaces./register: branded split register — cyclist onboarding & level 1 badge promise on left, registration form on right

visual_enhancers.tactical_hud: 1px emerald-500/20 & amber-500/20 borders with sharp corners, subtle inner glows and monospace telemetries
visual_enhancers.map_markers: Custom pulsating SVG markers for Buraco (vermelho), Obra (laranja), Trecho Inacabado (amarelo), Ciclovia Segura (verde esmeralda)
visual_enhancers.gamification_selos: Concentric metallic rings, glowing icons, animated unlock sparkles using Lucide icons + motion/react
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only on floating map HUD controls: bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-slate-700/50 shadow-2xl

motion.transitions: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out, transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out, opacity duration-200 ease-out
motion.radar_pulse: animate-ping for user live GPS location beacon
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap non-essential motion with motion/react respecting prefers-reduced-motion

accessibility.contrast_standards: All normal text >= 4.5:1; large headings >= 3.0:1 against designated surface backgrounds
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab order with visible ring-2 ring-emerald-400 focus offsets
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, map controls, tabs, modals)

instructions_to_main_agent.css_setup: Import leaflet/dist/leaflet.css in main.tsx or App.tsx. Include Outfit Variable and Plus Jakarta Sans Variable in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.fortaleza_routes_seed: Seed authentic Fortaleza cycling arteries (Ciclovia da Beira-Mar, Ciclofaixa da Av. Washington Soares, Ciclovia da Av. Aguanambi, Ciclovia da Av. Domingos Olímpio, Ciclofaixa da Santos Dumont, Ciclovia da Godofredo Maciel, etc.) with coordinates in GeoJSON / Leaflet polyline format.

instructions_to_main_agent.gps_alert_logic: Simulate or use navigator.geolocation to detect distance (Haversine formula). When distance to any obstacle < 200m, trigger a glowing alert banner and optional sound/speech alert ('Atenção: Buraco a 150 metros'). Provide a simulated GPS demo button for easy testing without moving physically.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: Include data-testid on every interactive button, map marker, input, filter, tab and alert modal.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rules: Always ensure text on dark backgrounds is at least slate-100 or slate-200. Muted labels must be at least slate-400 (minimum 4.5:1 ratio).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_readiness: Map controls and GPS tracker HUD must collapse gracefully on mobile screens with bottom navigation sheet support.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.real_time_sync: Use React Query with refetchInterval (e.g. 10000ms) or optimistic updates so new obstacles show up on the map immediately.
